### [Market Analytics & Investment Strategy: NYC Real Estate](nyc-realestate.qmd)

Conducted spatial analysis using GIS datasets across five NYC neighborhoods to evaluate land use, housing, and investment patterns.

**Tools:** Python, GIS, Clustering, Regression  
**Date:** December 2025

---

### [AI & Urban-Rural Job Market Disparities](ai-jobmarket.qmd)

Examined how AI reshapes job markets across urban and rural areas, analyzing skill demand, wage patterns, and geographic inequality using Lightcast job postings.

**Tools:** Python, Lightcast, Census Data, GeoPandas
